uiModel.shotsView: Stable order = read-model shots[] order (plan order); >6 shots supported (no six-shot ceiling); chunked/paginated rendering preserves order + indices; duration = targetFrames at 24fps via integer math. Provenance row: castBindings -> canon descriptions, location/prop/style revision pins; pinned reference asset IDs as IDs with explicit 'reference media not exposed by the read model' note.
uiModel.staleNotices: deriveStaleDependencyNotices(dependencyIssues) filtered to shot/shotplan rows + pinned-vs-active mismatch; rendered verbatim with pinnedDependencyId/activeDependencyId + code — never paraphrased away.
uiModel.approvalWorkspace: deriveApprovalReadiness(candidate, latestDecision, context): enabled ONLY when (a) candidate current, (b) full required checklist rendered with every item explicitly set, (c) all saved inputs displayed before submit, (d) advisory acknowledgements present when visionAssessment null or status!=='pass' (code 'vision_<status>', mirroring the server rule as client preflight). deriveApprovalCommand emits the exact POST body with expectedHash = the candidate's stable targetHash from its latest prior decision in read-model approvals[]. FROZEN DEGRADED STATE: a candidate with NO prior decision exposes no targetHash in the read model -> controls disabled with honest reason 'approval hash unavailable from the read model' (integrator proposal filed). Submit/animation buttons disabled whenever approval missing/pending/stale/rejected — disabled reason text always visible.
uiModel.takesView: Per shot: takeHistory siblings newest-first with decisions and selection state; selected take visually distinct + reversible via POST selection takeId:null; every selection carries expectedSelectionVersion (project-global CAS). Rejection/retake retains prior take; UI displays, never cascades.
uiModel.degradedOfflineStates: anchorHistory/takeHistory empty offline (no provider jobs) -> explicit empty states naming the prerequisite chain; selection/submit controls disabled with reasons; no fabricated candidates ever.
uiModel.loadingErrorRetry: Fetch phases idle/loading/failed; network failure -> role=alert + Retry, nothing lost; aborted mutations keep local state.
uiModel.keyboardA11y: Every control keyboard-reachable, visible label or aria-label, DOM-order focus, role=alert/status; chunk pagination keyboard-only operable.

decisions: Owns exactly the 6 contract files. No new API routes — read model v2 + approvals/selection/enqueue routes cover every enabled action.

FROZEN READ-MODEL GAPS (integrator proposals filed, no C08 action): (1) anchor/take media bytes — no asset records/byte-serving -> v1 shows metadata + decisions only; (2) first-decision expectedHash — approval hashes need asset.sha256 which the read model never exports -> candidates without prior decision cannot be approved from UI; proposal: small read-model amendment pre-slice BEFORE provider-era use (C13 needs it); (3) no per-shot job provenance beyond summaries.
Approval truth is the server route; UI reuses APPROVAL_CHECKLISTS + vision-acknowledgement rule read-only as preflight so UI-disabled and server 4xx cannot disagree by construction.

Submit (anchor/take generation) never auto-invoked; BUDGET_BLOCKED/unknown-entitlement envelopes render as the fault-matrix blocked state.
Visual conventions from components/production/project-canon.tsx + components/ui; no redesign, no new dependencies.
All other packets' files remain untouched (read-only).
